supplied.heading: 3. Leave > 3.1 Annual leave
supplied.text:
Annual leave is paid. The number of days depends on your length of service on 1 January of each year, and is counted in working days.
Length of service: Less than 2 years; Annual leave: 8 days; Sick leave (outpatient): 14 days
Length of service: 2 years to less than 5 years; Annual leave: 12 days; Sick leave (outpatient): 18 days
Length of service: 5 years or more; Annual leave: 16 days; Sick leave (outpatient): 22 days
Unused annual leave of up to 5 days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse without payment.

supplied.heading: 3. Leave > 3.2 How to apply for annual leave
supplied.text:
- For 1 or 2 days, apply at least 3 working days before the first day of leave.
- For 3 days or more, apply at least 14 days before the first day of leave.
- Apply in the HR portal. Your supervisor approves or declines within 2 working days.
- Leave is not approved during stocktake, which runs in the last week of June and the last week of December.

supplied.heading: 4. Claims and expenses > 4.1 What you can claim
supplied.text:
You may claim money you spent for company business when it was approved before the trip or purchase. The rates below apply to every employee.
Expense: Mileage, own car; Rate or limit: RM0.70 per km; Evidence needed: Trip log with start, end and purpose
Expense: Meal allowance, outstation; Rate or limit: RM30 per day; Evidence needed: Outstation for more than 8 hours; no receipt
Expense: Hotel, one night; Rate or limit: Up to RM180 in Kota Kinabalu, Sandakan or Tawau; up to RM150 elsewhere; Evidence needed: Hotel invoice
Expense: Flights; Rate or limit: Economy class, booked by the admin office; Evidence needed: Booking confirmation
Expense: Toll and parking; Rate or limit: Actual cost; Evidence needed: Receipt or e-wallet statement
Expense: Mobile phone, sales staff; Rate or limit: RM50 per month; Evidence needed: None, paid with salary
